lines.text: Paul says he has seen Jesus our Lord, and the Corinthians are the seal of his apostleship.
Paul asks if he and Barnabas are the only apostles who must work for a living.
The Law of Moses says not to muzzle an ox treading out the grain, and the plowman should share in the harvest.
Paul did not use his right to the Corinthians' support, and put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.
Paul says athletes train for a perishable crown, but he disciplines his body so he will not be disqualified.
